title: Gain of Entrainment in Ribosome Flow Models with Nonlinear Steric Hindrance: Global Rigidity and Dimension-Induced Gai
summary: The ribosome flow model (RFM) is a nonlinear compartmental model for unidirectional transport along an mRNA chain. We study a generalized RFM in which the classical linear free-space factor is replaced by a monotone nonlinear steric-hindrance response. After recalling the global equilibrium and periodic entrainment properties needed for the analysis, we derive an exact weighted edge-dissipation identity for the gain of entrainment (GOE).
